THIRD GOAT FROM THE LEFT
    Version 1.3 - December 1994
    by The Bard of Bizarre

"Third goat from the left -
 forgotten but true!
 I saw it all, from my
 front-stall pew."

You are the goat nobody
painted. Get from the
shepherds' field, through
Bethlehem and past the wise
men's camels, to the stable -
and take your place in the line
at the manger. Third from the
left.

Eat anything. Scream at your
fainting cousins (they keel
over stiff). Collect wool for
a gift. Do not kick the pail.

STARTING THE GAME
  Type GOAT and press Enter.
  VGA required. A Sound Blaster
  is recommended for the music
  and the singing.

FILES IN THIS ZIP
  GOAT.GAM     the game
  *.MAP        four levels
  GOAT.BBL     blocks
  *.SND        sound effects
  *.CMF        Sound Blaster
               music
  *.VOC        sampled sound
  *.GIF        pictures
  README.TXT   this file
  LICENSE.TXT  then and now

CREDITS (NOW)

  Left": lyrics shaped by

  Bizarre); the recording and

  The logo was made with

  Recreational Software
  Designs.

He sees you.

16.long: Walk up and to the left.

18.long: Walk up and to the right.

57.long: Scream the way you last walked. It costs one breath. Fainting cousins keel over and pigeons flee.

79.long: Walk down and to the left.

81.long: Walk down and to the right.

1.long: Scream the way you last walked. It costs one breath.
